name: nz-ea-wholesale-price-exceedance

source.publisher: Electricity Authority (Te Mana Hiko) - EMI datasets 'Final energy prices' and 'Network supply points table'
source.vintage: container listed 2026-10-23: 728 blobs (360 monthly 199610..202609 ~8.2-10.9 MB each, 368 daily since 2025-10-21 ~0.31-0.35 MB each; 3 interim and 1 incomplete variant excluded and counted); monthly channel owns trading dates <= 2025-10-31, daily channel owns dates > 2025-10-31; the 10 overlap days 2025-10-22..31 cross-checked between channels (18 island-days compared, max |island mean diff| 0.0)

nsp_table.note: current-vintage POC -> island mapping, 2,633 rows / 894 distinct POCs; POCs absent from it are excluded from island aggregation and counted per year

source.fetch_provenance: worker job nz-ea-002 (server 172091812, cx23/hel1, 91 min, exit 0) fetched the publisher directly; the bytes never passed through the coordinator. Per-file digests for all 714 price files are recorded in the job's summary.json (staging release 422246241)

grain: one row per (island, anchor trading day D); row_id = {island}-{anchor_date}; history window 30 published days, horizon 7 trading days, instant lag 6 calendar days

coverage.unmapped_poc_rows_note: rows whose POC is absent from the current-vintage NetworkSupplyPointsTable (retired POCs) are excluded from island aggregation and counted per year in the job summary; 199610 first-day sample: 213/225 mapped

threshold.decision: NZD 100/MWh fixed from the training-window design: the candidate record measured candidate levels on era samples (2020-06: 28/12/5/0 days above 100/150/200/300), and the Authority's own review records 2019 average spot price $127/MWh and 2020 $105/MWh, so NZD 100 keeps clustered positive weeks measurable in every split while remaining roughly twice the long-run median; chosen before construction and never tuned on a held-out score

holdout.anchor_days: 2022-11-01 .. 2026-10-16 (real-time pricing regime from the documented 2022-11-01 change; a different market regime by design - per-year reporting is mandatory when interpreting it)

known_event_fixtures.aug_2024_dry_year: four fixture days 2024-08-05..08 measured market daily means 814.77 / 861.95 / 883.56 / 825.31, all in the expected 700-1000 range and exceeding the threshold (Authority Review of winter 2024: 'in early August the average daily price reached $820/MWh'); asserted in-build from the constructed panel
known_event_fixtures.winter_2008: 2008-07-01 market daily mean 305.79 exceeds the threshold (record-measured 306 on the 2008 winter dry-year)
known_event_fixtures.quiet_era_control: January 1997 market daily means max 50.0, below the threshold (quiet-era control)

reference_baselines.note: stdlib rank AUC measured post-acceptance on the written eval rows by score.py (job nz-ea-002), rate tables estimated on train rows only; independently recomputed by reference_check.py in job nz-ea-baseline-003 with exact agreement on every value

paired_persistence_value_vs_mean7.note: inconclusive: the two persistence variants are not distinguishable on eval

baseline_full_model.runner: the benchmark's own train.py + validate.sh, unmodified (bundled sha256 equal the benchmark's declared hashes: train.py a3c6bcf1..., validate.py b597e7f8..., validate.sh 3f06ca48...)
baseline_full_model.predeclared_criterion: headroom demonstrated only if the model exceeds persistence_mean7 AND the week-clustered paired interval for (model - persistence_mean7) excludes zero
baseline_full_model.verdict_under_criterion: NOT demonstrated: the observed advantage is positive but the dependence-aware interval contains zero - an inconclusive difference, neither parity nor a trailing-model defect; calendar-only is beaten decisively
baseline_full_model.note: 0.8924 vs persistence_value 0.8820 / persistence_mean7 0.8843 / calendar-only 0.5011 on the identical 4,992 eval rows; no holdout AUC is quoted (the holdout never enters a workdir; it is the post-2022-11 real-time pricing regime, prevalence 0.544)

timing.prediction_instant: publication of final prices for trading day D, conservatively placed at D + 6 calendar days
timing.documented_rule: the Authority states interim prices 'will be declared to be final prices by 2pm the following business day' (Real-time dispatch and pricing page + Code Part 13)
timing.measured_lag_all_daily_files: Last-Modified minus trade date over all 368 daily files: min 0.75 d, p50 1.80 d, p90 3.80 d, max 5.80 d
timing.instant_choice: D + 6 calendar days covers the measured maximum publication lag, so every shipped feature (final prices for trading days <= D) is published at the instant, and the target trading day D+7 has not finished trading there under any publication scheme
timing.no_early_target_knowledge: the label reads the D+7 island mean, which cannot exist at the instant; the D+7 label source columns are excluded from every shipped file
timing.vintage_caveat: the EMI container publishes current final prices only; historical vintages are not exposed, so a true point-in-time reconstruction of past publication states is not performable. The monthly-channel files carrying pre-2022 dates were themselves uploaded 2022-10-31 (Last-Modified measured), so feature values are stated as current-vintage with the cutoff a documented assumption anchored on the publisher's own documented finality rule and the measured daily-channel lags

prevalence_shift_note: train 0.199 -> eval 0.431 -> holdout 0.544 (gate-recorded): the eval window is prevalence-shifted relative to training and the holdout sits in the post-2022-11 real-time pricing regime; any score is as much out-of-distribution as temporal, and per-year rates are reported rather than smoothed
